claim: Shen Ji New Village is a former Taiwan Provincial Government auditing-office dormitory compound in West District, redeveloped into a cultural-creative base of shops and studios.
quote: Shen Ji New Village... a dorm compound built by the Taiwan Provincial Government nearly half a century ago to accommodate employees of the auditing office... transformed into a lively and innovative base for young entrepreneurs.

claim: Shenji New Village (審計新村) literally translates to 'Audit New Village' — the two names refer to the same 0.52-hectare site in West District, now artist studios, creative shops and markets.
quote: Shenji New Village (審計新村) translates to 'Audit New Village,' with 'Shenji' referring to auditing... redeveloped into a cultural and creative center featuring artist studios, creative shops and markets... in West District, Taichung, spanning 0.52 hectares.

claim: Rainbow Village in Nantun District remains open and free in 2026, but is significantly diminished: ~50% of original murals were vandalized in 2022, the cafe and gift shop have closed, and an apartment building was built adjacent.
quote: Approximately 50% of the original artwork was vandalized in 2022 during a contract dispute... The café and gift shop that once operated there have closed... A large apartment building was constructed immediately adjacent to the house.

claim: Huang Yung-fu, the self-taught painter nicknamed 'Rainbow Grandpa' (彩虹爺爺), died on 23 January 2024 at age 100; the site is a single former military-dependents' house rather than a true village.
quote: Huang died on 23 January 2024 at the age of 100... went by the nickname Rainbow Grandpa (彩虹爺爺)... the site is just one house and not a 'village' as the name may suggest.

claim: The Calligraphy Greenway is a ~2.5 km green corridor running from the National Museum of Natural Science past the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts to the Liuchuan Canal, lined with around 200 independent shops, plazas and weekend markets.
quote: Taichung's green runway—linking science, art, and everyday beauty... Length: 2.5 kilometers... Around 200 unique local stores... Begins at the National Museum of Natural Science, passes the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, and extends to Liuchuan Canal.

claim: The CMP Block Museum of Arts is an open-air 'living museum' of ~2,500 sqm with interactive art installations, sited north of Caowu Square behind the Park Lane by CMP mall.
quote: The CMP Block Museum of Arts is an art space north of Caowu Square, behind Park Lane by CMP shopping mall, and is branded as a 'living museum' with an al fresco gallery space featuring interactive art exhibits. It offers 2500 square meters of open space.

claim: Taichung Cultural Heritage Park (Cultural and Creative Industries Park) occupies the 1916 Japanese-era Taishō brewery — the largest brewery in Taiwan — next to Taichung Railway Station, reopened as a free creative-industries venue in 2009.
quote: originally built in 1916 as a brewery factory during the Japanese rule... Taishō Brewing Joint-stock Company, which was the largest brewery in Taiwan... In 2009, it was opened to the public as the Taichung Cultural and Creative Industries Park.

claim: Fantasy Story (Green Ray) is a revitalized cluster of old water-utility dormitories on Lane 117 Meicun Rd, Xiangshang N Rd and Zhongxing 1st Lane in West District, now bookstores, boutiques, galleries and cafes promoting Taiwanese artists.
quote: Fantasy Story Green Ray is a renovation plan implemented in old dormitories of the water corporation... The area covers Lane 117 of Meicun Rd, Sec 1, Xiangshang North Rd and Zhongxing 1st Lane in the West District.

claim: West District is Taichung's most walkable neighbourhood, with the Calligraphy Greenway (草悟道 / Caowu) corridor letting visitors loop the science museum, fine-arts museum, Shenji New Village and Qinmei cluster on foot with almost no transport.
quote: West District is Taichung's most walkable neighbourhood, with the Calligraphy Greenway running north-south entirely on foot... Museum, botanical garden, Shenji New Village, and Qinmei cluster tight with half-day loops needing almost no transport.

claim: PARK2 Caowu Square is an open-air West District complex mixing cafes, restaurants, dessert shops and creative brands in minimalist architecture with shaded walkways and pop-up events, a relaxed stop on the Caowu walk.
quote: PARK2 Caowu Square is a modern and versatile space located in Taichung's West District that seamlessly combines shops, restaurants, and green outdoor areas. Shaded walkways, outdoor seating, and frequent pop-up events make it a relaxed place to stroll, dine, and socialize.
